build_evaluation_metrics: build a metrics computation function using get_spj_evaluation with a tokenizer and generator config
postprocess_predictions: postprocess model predictions and labels by stripping special tokens and splitting by answer delimiter
compute_exact_match: compute exact match and case insensitive exact match scores between decoded predictions and labels
write_predictions_file: write prediction label and metadata pairs to a JSON lines file for later inspection
breakdown_score_by_type: compute exact match breakdown scores grouped by question type and relation using breakdown_score
